options.text: Unlike poles on the same side, wood between them, and hard steel pieces across the ends.
Unlike poles on the same side, wood between them, and soft iron keepers across the ends.
Unlike poles on the same side, soft iron between them, and wood across the ends.
Unlike poles on the same side, magnets touching with no wood, and soft iron keepers across the ends.

stem:
Mohit stores a pair of bar magnets. Safe storage uses unlike poles on the same side, a wooden piece between the magnets, and soft iron keepers across the ends. He also has hard steel pieces and could leave out the wood.

Which storage choice is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Safe pair storage keeps unlike poles aligned, wood between the magnets, and soft iron keepers across the ends.
